metadata.name: MIF4 Cradle
metadata.description: Rosendahl MIF4 cradle. 193x111x68.5mm ext, 169x111x44.5 cavity (0.5 clearance). 12mm walls throughout with mounts sunk flush - no protrusions. Open front/rear. Top plate 3x 3/8"-16 + 4x 1/4"-20; each wall 1x 3/8"-16 + 2x 1/4"-20. All captive hex nut.
